content.text:
好，材料已经到位。下面按照你的要求来。

---

## 例子：`b = a` 是什么意思？

假设我们有一个对象被变量 `a` 引用：

```js
const a = { count: 1 };
```

在内存中：

```
    a  ───→  { count: 1 }   （一个对象）
```

然后执行：

```js
const b = a;
```

**这里复制的是引用（reference），而不是对象本身。** 现在两个变量指向**同一个对象**：

```
    a  ───→  { count: 1 }
    b  ───→      ↑
               同一个
```

接着做修改：

```js
b.count += 1;
console.log(a.count); // 2
console.log(b.count); // 2
```

因为 `a` 和 `b` 指向的是同一个对象，无论通过哪个变量修改，另一个变量也能看到变化。

---

## 对比：如果创建一个新对象

```js
const copy = { ...a };   // 扩展运算符创建新对象
```

```
    a  ───→  { count: 1 }
    b  ───→       ↑
                 同一个
    copy ──→  { count: 1 }   （全新的对象）
```

这时 `copy.count` 改变不会影响 `a.count`。

tools.name: reopen_future_attention

Copy an exact correction excerpt. Reopening preserves the old transition and creates no evidence.

tools.name: retain_learning_wide_timed_steering
tools.description: Retain an explicit learner instruction that is already in force only when it must constrain Tutor behavior after the current model sample or in a later Session. This is temporary policy, not a stable preference, future learning appointment, or learning evidence. validUntil is an expiry, not a future activation time. Copy an exact excerpt from the current learner input and supply an ISO-8601 expiry with an explicit offset.

tools.name: inspect_active_course_view
tools.description: Inspect a bounded page of the immutable active Course View, including stable item IDs, parent links, authored ordinals, and titles. Use this before describing or correcting parts outside the compact nearby context. It returns no material prose.

tools.name: set_course_route_anchor
tools.description: Correct durable route position to an authored ordinal in the active Course View. Use when the learner corrects where they are or explicitly asks to jump. This changes navigation only, never mastery or Course View structure.

tools.name: realign_current_markdown_course
tools.description: Observe the registered Markdown artifact again and, only if its content revision changed while the current anchor still exists, supersede the source-grounded Course View and material alignments explicitly. Pass no path or revision.

tools.name: read_current_course_material
tools.description: Read only the exact revision-bound material range aligned to the active course item. The system supplies the trusted course, item, path, revision, and bounds; pass no path or IDs.
